hero.heading: Duke's Earthworks — Skid Steer Work Done Right
hero.subheading: Honest work. Quality results. Milton, FL based.

story_paragraphs: Duke's Earthworks is owned and operated by Jonathan Smyly, a Northwest Florida native who grew up in Beulah and has called Milton home for years. With a background in mechanics and hands-on trades, Jonathan has always worked with his hands — and he's always done it right.

After years of taking on every kind of service job through his previous business, Infinite Services of NWF, Jonathan saw a clear need in the Emerald Coast market: property owners and contractors who needed reliable, no-nonsense skid steer work — grading, clearing, driveway prep, erosion control — done by someone who actually shows up and gets it done. So he invested in a John Deere skid steer and went all in.

He's not trying to be everything to everyone anymore. Duke's Earthworks is focused on one thing — skid steer work — and doing it better than anyone else on the Emerald Coast. Whether it's a homeowner who needs a driveway graded or a contractor who needs a lot cleared for a new build, Jonathan brings the same work ethic to every job: show up on time, do honest work, and leave the property better than you found it.
why_families: Focused skid steer expertise — not a general contractor spreading thin
Professional John Deere skid steer maintained to the highest standard
Local knowledge of Emerald Coast soil, drainage, and terrain
Equipped to handle jobs of any size
Honest, straightforward communication with fair pricing
closing_text: From the first quote to the final walkthrough, Jonathon's goal is simple: show up, do quality work, and leave you with a job well done. No games, no runaround — just dependable skid steer services you can count on.
closing_cta: Ready to get your project moving?
